name: Draw
doc: Draw (Lefty's enemy attack; the act family): one emitter per action - its sounds, an actor system (its actor data the exe's) and the drawn magic: twisted ribbons from round the target to the caster, their sparks; the damage. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag015_draw.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its state functions called from the phases, its parts spawned by it): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own - and the exe data words pointing into it (the engine's global index, the word)

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: The act family's master: once its children are gone, the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the actor counters cleared every tick

pools.doc: the ribbon spawner, the ribbons and their sparks (the port's)
run by the master, nothing spawned there

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sounds, the actor system (its actor data the exe's), the master's release, the damage

parts.title: Ribbons
parts.doc: The drawn magic: twisted ribbons from round the target to the caster, their sparks

groups.label: Sounds
groups.doc: Played at the emitter's first tick (sound ids)

params.label: Next action at tick
params.doc: The master goes on to the next action at this tick

params.label: Actor ticks
params.doc: The actor system spawns for this many ticks

params.label: Actor mode
params.doc: Where it takes its reference points (0: the bones)

params.label: Twist
params.doc: A ribbon's twist a tick (4096: a turn)

params.label: Spread
params.doc: How far from the emitter's midpoint the ribbons start

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 6 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Ribbon
params.doc: The sprite sequence ribbon (a flipbook of 6 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sounds, the actor system and the ribbon spawner, the master's release, the damage.
